customManagers.description: The healthchecks image in the Taskfile is written repo:tag@sha256:digest; the shape is what is matched
A version an action reads from its version input, with a # renovate: comment above it that names the release source

packageRules.description: A tool version in the Dockerfile has the hash of its SHA256SUMS file beside it, which no registry gives: each tool is its own pull request, whose image build fails until the hash is changed with it
